Freight forwarders across the US and Mexico to gain access to real-time eBooking and integrated payment workflows for mas’s 100% freighter network


**Barcelona, Spain** — Freightos Limited (NASDAQ: CRGO), the leading booking and payment platform for the international freight industry, today announced an upcoming platform integration with mas, a premier cargo airline specializing in dedicated freighter operations across Latin America. The agreement will bring mas’s widebody freighter capacity onto the Freightos platform, allowing freight forwarders to seamlessly book and pay for air cargo in real time.


The rollout will provide forwarders operating in major gateways—specifically Los Angeles and across Mexico—with instant access to mas’s all-freighter fleet. The partnership expands main-deck capacity options on key trade lanes connecting North America to high-demand destinations across Latin America.


To eliminate financial friction at the point of sale, the integration will combine instant eBooking with Freightos Pay. By integrating flexible digital payment functionalities directly into the booking process, the partnership addresses a primary friction point for freight forwarders: cash-flow constraints and administrative delays. Instead of navigating complex bank guarantees or upfront settlement hurdles to secure main-deck space, forwarders will be able to lock in critical capacity immediately while benefiting from flexible payment terms that keep working capital liquid.


“Securing main-deck freighter capacity across Latin American corridors has required manual quote cycles and rigid payment structures,” said Pablo Pinillos, CEO of Freightos. “By pairing mas’s dedicated widebody network with Freightos Pay, we are replacing administrative friction with instant execution. Forwarders will be able to secure the specialized capacity they need on demand while optimizing their cash flow through streamlined digital payment terms.”


“Expanding our digital distribution on Freightos will allow us to connect directly with thousands of active forwarders at the precise moment they are looking for capacity,” said Eduardo Cedilli, Senior Manager, Sales at mas. “Integrating eBooking alongside Freightos Pay modernizes our commercial operations—giving our customers in the US and Mexico a faster, more flexible way to book and pay for freighter space across our Latin American network.”


Digital Transformation Director at mas, Victor Flores, added “This partnership represents another important milestone in the evolution of mas as a modern cargo airline. By combining our freighter network with digital distribution and payment capabilities, we are enhancing customer experience, improving operational agility, and expanding our reach to new markets and customers.”


## **About Freightos**


Freightos® (NASDAQ: CRGO) is the leading digital infrastructure platform powering the international freight industry. Operating as a vendor-neutral network, Freightos connects airlines, ocean carriers, trucking carriers, freight forwarders, and importers and exporters of all sizes to bring transparency, efficiency, and resilience to global supply chains.


The Freightos platform digitalizes freight execution by transforming manual, fragmented processes into seamless, connected, and data-driven digital workflows. Freightos delivers integrated capabilities including procurement, pricing, quoting, booking, customs clearance, payments, and market intelligence across air, ocean, and road freight. By serving as the intelligence middleware layer that unifies data and workflows, Freightos empowers smarter operational decisions and enables market participants to transact, collaborate, and manage global shipments more effectively.


Used by thousands of logistics service providers and businesses around the world, Freightos combines software, network connectivity, transaction infrastructure, and market data into an interconnected digital ecosystem.
